detail.title: 8+4MP 25x TiOC Network Panoramic PTZ Camera
detail.overview: Compare Favourite SDT4E425-8P-GB-APV1 8+4MP 25x TiOC Network Panoramic PTZ Camera Key Points • Captures a Large Area and Great Details at the Same Time • High-Quality Imaging with 8MP Resolution for Bullet Channel, 4MP for PTZ Channel • 180° Wide Angle Splicing Image Monitoring • Auto Tracking 3.0：Effective Target Monitoring with Detailed Intruder Trajectories • Active Deterrence: Audible and Visual Alarms Can Be Triggered by Certain Events to Drive Away the Target • IP66 & TVS 6000V Protection with Lightning/Surge/Voltage Transient Resistance Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.Image Sensor: Overview channel: 1/2.7" CMOS; Detail channel: 1/2.8" CMOS
General.Pixel: Overview channel: 8 MP; Detail channel: 4 MP
General.Min. Illumination: Overview channel: 0.005 lux@F1.4 (Color, 30 IRE); 0.0005 lux@F1.4 (B/W, 30 IRE); 0 lux (illuminator on) Detail channel: 0.005 lux@F1.6 (Color, 30 IRE); 0.0005 lux@F1.6 (B/W, 30 IRE); 0 lux (illuminator on)
General.Illumination Distance: Overview channel: 30 m (98.43 ft) (IR); 30 m (98.43 ft) (white light); Detail channel: 100 m (328.08 ft) (IR); 50 m (131.23 ft) (white light)
General.Illuminator On/Off Control: Overview channel: Manual; Auto; Off Detail channel: Zoom Prio; Manual; Auto; Off
General.Illuminator Number: Overview channel: 2 (IR light); 2 (White light); Detail channel: 2 (IR light); 2 (Warm light)
General.Focal Length: Overview channel: 2.8 mm; Detail channel: 5 mm–125 mm
General.Max. Aperture: Overview channel: F1.4; Detail channel: F1.6-F3.6
General.Field of View: Overview channel: H: 180°; V: 86°; Detail channel: H: 51.9°–3.0°; V: 39.7°–2.2°; D: 63.1°–3.7°
General.Close Focus Distance: Overview channel: 0.6 m (1.97 ft); Detail channel: 0.1 m–0.5 m (0.33"–1.64")
General.Iris Control: Overview channel: NA; Detail channel: Auto; manual; iris prio
General.Pan/Tilt Range: Pan: 0° to 360° endless Tilt: –15° to +90°, auto flip 180°
General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): Tripwire; intrusion; crossing fence detection; loitering detection; abandoned/missing object; fast moving; parking detection; people gathering; human alarm classification; linkage tracking
General.Acupick: Uses deep learning algorithms and works with backend devices to accurately match targets, such as people and motor vehicles, and search through live and recorded videos to quickly locate targets (Overview channel support)
General.Auto Patrol: After an IVS alarm is triggered, it can link with up to 5 presets or scan to patrol the key areas. IVS can be enabled with SMD at the same time.
General.Light Warning: Red-Blue light warning; Flash duration: 5 s–30 s; Flash frequency: high, medium, low
General.Sound Warning: Offers 11 sound alarm and 10 custom sound alarms can be imported. Sound can be set from 0%–100%. Play times can be set from 1-10.
General.Video Frame Rate: Overview channel: Main stream: 4096 × 1860 @(1–25/30 fps) Sub stream 1: 1024 × 448/D1/VGA/CIF @(1–25/30 fps) Sub stream 2: 2048 × 928/1080p/1.3M/720p @(1–25/30 fps); Detail channel: Main stream: 4M/3M/1080p/1.3M/720p @(1–25/30 fps) Sub stream 1: D1/VGA/CIF @(1–25/30 fps) Sub stream 2: 1080p/1.3M/720p/ @(1–25/30 fps)
General.Video Bit Rate: Overview channel: H264: 128 kbps–16,384 kbps H265: 51 kbps–13,312 kbps; Detail channel: H264: 96 kbps–16,384 kbps H265: 38 kbps–10,240 kbps
General.Day/Night: Overview channel: Auto; Color; B/W; Electronic Detail channel: Auto; Color; B/W; Electronic
General.WDR: Overview channel: DWDR; Detail channel: 120 dB
General.White Balance: Overview channel: Auto; indoor; outdoor; tracking; manual; sodium lamp; natural light; street lamp Detail channel: Auto; indoor; outdoor; tracking; manual; sodium lamp; natural light; street lamp
General.Gain Control: Overview channel: Auto; manual; gain prio Detail channel: Auto; manual; gain prio
General.Noise Reduction: Overview channel: 2D NR; 3D NR Detail channel: Auto: 2D NR; 3D NR
General.Image Stabilization: Overview channel: NA Detail channel: Electronic Image Stabilization (EIS)
General.Defog: Overview channel: Electronic Detail channel: Electronic
General.S/N Ratio: Overview channel: ≥55 dB Detail channel: ≥55 dB
General.Privacy Masking: Up to 24 areas can be set, with up to 8 areas in the same view Multiple colors and mosaic available
General.Network Protocol: HTTP; HTTPS; TCP/IP; IPv4; RTSP; UDP; SMTP; NTP; DHCP; DNS; DDNS; IPv6; 802.1x; SSL; QoS; FTP; UPnP; ICMP; SNMP; IGMP; ARP; RTCP; RTP; PPPoE; RTMP; Bonjour; NFS
General.Interoperability: ONVIF (Profile S & Profile G & Profile T & Profile M);CGI;SDK;P2P
General.Storage: Micro SD card (512 GB); FTP/SFTP; NAS
General.Browser: web5.0: IE 9 and later versions; Chrome 41 and later versions; Firefox 52 and later versions; Safari 10 and later versions
General.Alarm Input: 2 channels in: supports wet contact connection (max load 5 mA 3–5 VDC); supports dry contact connection
General.Alarm Output: 1 channel out: dry contact, max load 1,000 mA 30 VDC/500 mA 50 VAC
General.Alarm Linkage: Capture; recording; send email; preset; tour; pattern; alarm digital output; audio; warning light
General.Alarm Event: Motion/tampering detection; network disconnection detection; IP conflict detection; memory card state detection; memory space detection
General.Power Consumption: Basic: 14 W; Max: 25 W (illuminator + heating glass + Siren and Light Active Deterrence + ICR + PTZ)
General.Protection: IP66; TVS 6000 V lightning proof; surge protection; voltage transient protection
